objectives.pips: Total pips of A1 and A2; ignores resource mix, ports, numbers and game value.
objectives.weighted_pips: Total resource pips of A1 and A2 weighted by the frozen A1 resource-only regression; logit-scale production proxy, not game value.
objectives.a2_preference: Fixed training-only A2 coverage-regression score, with the unidentifiable A1-specific intercept set to zero. Cross-A1 comparisons depend on this convention and cannot establish state value.

regression_feature_convention: For production objectives, added optimistic/worst features contain A2 production only; A1 production is already controlled. Descriptive objective comparisons retain combined A1+A2 production.
limitations: Worst replies minimize A future-site proxy rather than maximizing B win probability.
Only settlement legality is enumerated; roads are immaterial to setup settlement legality but matter to game value.
Recorded B responses apply only to the actual chosen A1; no counterfactual opponent inference is made for alternative A1.
No neuron tracing or proof of explicit search/computation inside the frozen policy.
Paired test boards are independent; candidate corners within a board are not treated as independent samples.
Intervals describe board sampling conditional on fixed training fits; they omit training-set/model uncertainty.
